connector.name: Planetary Agents
connector.registryDescription: Converse with planetary-agent personas, council feeds & culinary debates from alchm.kitchen
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package alchm-planetary-agents-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the gregcastro23 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: PLANETARY_AGENTS_BACKEND_URL
env.description: Base URL of the Planetary Agents FastAPI backend that serves persona chat. Defaults to http://localhost:8000 for local dev; set to https://api.agents.alchm.kitchen to use the hosted service.

env.name: PLANETARY_AGENTS_FRONTEND_URL
env.description: Base URL of the Planetary Agents frontend, used by get_agent_feed_discussion to read council-feed threads. Defaults to http://localhost:3000; set to https://agents.alchm.kitchen for the hosted feed.

env.name: PLANETARY_AGENTS_MCP_MODEL_TIER
env.description: Default model tier for persona responses: free | cheap_fast | primary | reflective. Defaults to free (the hosted backend reserves paid tiers).
